ACCESSORY USE OR STRUCTURE - A use or structure subordinate to the principle use of a building on the same lot and serving a purpose customarily incidental to the use of the principle building or use. AGRICULTURE - The use of land for agricultural and forestry purposes, including farming, dairying, pasturage, apiculture, horticulture, floriculture, viticulture, silviculture, and animal and poultry husbandry, and the necessary accessory used for packing, treating, or storing the produce; provided, however, that the operation of any such accessory uses shall be secondary to that of normal agricultural and silvicultural activities and provided further that the above uses shall not include the commercial feeding of garbage or offal to swine or other animals.
